# InSituPy SpatialData Integration (insitupy.spatialdata)

Requires the `spatialdata` package: `pip install spatialdata`

## convert_to_spatialdata(data: Union[insitupy._core.data.InSituData, ForwardRef('InSituExperiment')], n_pyramids: int = 5, include_transcripts: bool = True, include_concat_tables: bool = True)
  Convert an InSituData or InSituExperiment object to a SpatialData object.

  Integrates images, cell tables, cell shapes, spatial units, transcripts,
  annotations, regions, and cell boundary labels into a single SpatialData object.
  Automatically detects and resolves case-insensitive key conflicts that would
  cause problems when writing to disk.

  Requires the ``spatialdata`` package (``pip install spatialdata``).

## convert_from_spatialdata(sdata: spatialdata._core.spatialdata.SpatialData, verbose: bool = True) -> insitupy._core.data.InSituData | insitupy.experiment.data.InSituExperiment
  Convert an InSituPy-dialect SpatialData object back into an InSituData or InSituExperiment.

  A true inverse of :func:`convert_to_spatialdata`: the dialect and every
  modality-naming detail (pixel sizes, RGB-ness, per-cell-layer boundaries,
  per-unit-layer tables, ...) are auto-detected from the store itself and
  ``sdata.attrs["insitupy_spatialdata_dialect"]`` - no caller-supplied keys
  or pixel sizes are needed. Returns a bare ``InSituData`` for a
  single-sample store (no ``SAMPLE.<uid>..`` prefix in any element key), or
  an ``InSituExperiment`` of ``InSituData`` objects for a multi-sample store.

## Usage

```python
import insitupy as ispy

# Export to SpatialData
data = ispy.InSituData.read("path/to/project/")
sdata = ispy.spatialdata.convert_to_spatialdata(data, n_pyramids=3)

# Import from SpatialData
data = ispy.spatialdata.convert_from_spatialdata(
    sdata,
    image_data=("image", 0.2125),   # (image_key, pixel_size_µm)
    table_key="table",
    slide_id="my_slide",
)
```

## Notes
- `convert_to_spatialdata` wraps InSituData images, cell tables, and shapes.
- `convert_from_spatialdata` reconstructs an InSituData from a SpatialData object.
- The `image_data` parameter accepts a tuple or list of tuples: `(key, pixel_size)`.
- Use `check_and_fix_case_insensitive_conflicts()` if SpatialData has key conflicts.
